item.title: Week 11: Buccaneers at Lions
item.description: Sun 11/22 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: DET -6.5 · O/U 46.5 | Model DET 74% vs. market 70% | Tampa Bay must hunt chunk plays against a Detroit defense that allows explosives on 9.4% of snaps, because its passing offense ranks last in EPA per dropback. Baker Mayfield, averaging -1.26 EPA per dropback under pressure, faces a Detroit pass rush that ranks 3rd. Our model sits above the market at 74% for Detroit versus 70%, driven mostly by the quarterback gap.
